narr: A slow moving front caused showers and thunderstorms to develop. Deep moisture caused heavy rainfall, and with the slower movement of storms this led to instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Numerous roads were reported flooded throughout Hagerstown. Multiple water rescues were reported as well due to high water along roadways.
